title: Insurer Glass Program Terms Schedule (Auto Glass Services)
content:
Insurer relations schedule of Crestline Collision & Glass for **Auto Glass Services** jobs paid through an insurer's glass program. It states, per tier, whether the insurer's glass claim or referral number must be carried at scheduling, whether the insurer's glass deductible applies, the insurer's payment terms, and the repricing percentage above which an insurer adjustment is disputed.

### Schedule entries

1. **Claim number at scheduling** — whether an insurance glass claim job must carry the insurer's glass claim or referral number at scheduling (boolean).
2. **Deductible applies** — whether the insurer's glass deductible applies to the job (boolean).
3. **Insurer payment terms** — calendar days after billing within which the insurer is expected to pay (integer).
4. **Dispute threshold** — insurer repricing, as a percentage of the billed amount, above which the adjustment is disputed instead of accepted (percent).

### Per-tier values

| Tier | 1. Claim number at scheduling | 2. Deductible applies | 3. Insurer payment terms (calendar days) | 4. Dispute threshold (percent of billed amount) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Windshield Chip Repair | No | No | 30 | 5 |
| Side Glass Replacement | Yes | Yes | 30 | 5 |
| Rear Glass Replacement | Yes | Yes | 30 | 5 |
| Windshield Replacement | Yes | Yes | 30 | 5 |
| Camera-Equipped Windshield Replacement | Yes | Yes | 30 | 5 |
| Premium Feature Windshield Replacement | Yes | Yes | 30 | 5 |

### Remarks

- Windshield Chip Repair is the one tier on which neither the claim number at scheduling nor the deductible is called for; on the five replacement tiers both entries read Yes.
- The payment terms (30 calendar days after billing) and the dispute threshold (5 percent of the billed amount) are the same on all six tiers.

*Hypothetical figure:* on a billing of 600.00 on any tier, 5 percent of the billed amount is 30.00; a repricing reduction above 30.00 is above the threshold, and a reduction of 30.00 or less is not.
